items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: a guy that was Guy Anselmo's orchestra that was playing for the pitcher so it was his piano player that done the playing but I was just jiving you know but you did the singing I done the singing

ctx.x: There's one thing I do want to ask before this thing runs out Lizzie and that's about this movie You were in the movies?

Oh yeah with this circus I was with out in California Well they hide the whole circus you see and uh it was Bessie Love Bessie Love starring Bessie Love in the Stardust Ring She was supposed to be a big bareback rider you know see and they took the whole circus to the parade and everything and of course on the stage in the sideshow I sang and danced walking the dog with some fellas and then in the back of the tent they gave me a big pair of drawers the fat lady drawers made me hang them on the line you know and…
Did you sing in the circus picture too?
